crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, rounded reddish-pink patch located on the crown and extending to the nape area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear transition in color from the reddish nape to the brownish-gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly visible, high-contrast white rump patch located superior to the dark tail feathers.
